text:
vik_sales: Quick pass to CS — Sapphire Health (acct sapphire-312). They're ~60 days to renewal, procurement lead changed last week and pushing extra security controls. Sales discussed private VPC + SSO + EU data residency. They asked for a dedicated-capacity estimate but procurement is stalling on cost/SLA. Major renewal risk if review drags >30 days. Key context below.

vik_sales: TL;DR: primary product use = claims extraction + summarization, tested hosted API and saw cost spikes; they asked for a private deploy to control unit economics. Procurement deadline 60d; legal/compliance needs PHI handling doc.

marta_cs: Thanks Vik — taking point from CS. Can someone drop the current env details + expected QPS and a small sample of prompts? I’ll start a customer-facing enablement plan and book a kickoff.

vik_sales: Env: prod, org_id: sapphire-312. Expected steady qps 12–18, peak ~40 rps. p50 latency target 150ms. They used redwood/open-7b-v1 via hosted for PoC. Primary sample prompt type: free-text claim -> structured fields extraction. Will attach example set.

julia_support: cc eng-infra. I opened a support ticket for infra/provisioning and compliance — SUP-8421 (https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SUP-8421). Need IdP metadata + SSO certs from customer, and confirmation of PHI handling. Adding sensitivity tag.

sam_eng: Put me on this — I'll validate perf for dedicated pools. Important: we need model artifact name/version, tokenization details, and a few long-sequence examples (4k-ish) to simulate worst-case. Also flag: quantized path can change latency; will capture perf variance.

vik_sales: Model they used: `redwood/open-7b-v1`. Sharing an anonymized eval set in Drive: https://drive.redwood/sapphire-evals (will send access). Procurement wants cost/SLA estimate + recommended rollout plan.

marta_cs: Action items (capturing for runbook):
1) CS (marta_cs) — collect eval set + schedule enablement call with customer this week (aim Thu).
2) Support (julia_support) — follow up on SUP-8421, request IdP metadata, certs, and confirm PHI scope; attach to ticket.
3) Eng (sam_eng) — perf & capacity estimate for dedicated pool + note on quantization impact, deliver by EOD Thu.
4) Sales (vik_sales) — intro to current procurement lead (cc'd) and share contract timing window.
Please ack or edit. :thumbsup:

oncall-bot: SUP-8421 created by julia_support — assigned to eng-infra. ETA 3 days. :white_check_mark:

julia_support: Added sensitivity tag `PHI` and requested SOC2/KMS confirmation from security. Also asked customer for SSO IdP metadata and certs (requested today).

sam_eng: Noted PHI requirement. I’ll run a dedicated-pool perf sim with the same model and the long-sequence samples once artifacts + eval set are available. Expect initial numbers in 48–72h. If we need pre-warmed KV caches for the workload, I'll include ops runbook.

vik_sales: I'll schedule a procurement sync Tue 10am PT and invite marta_cs, julia_support, sam_eng. Also will ask customer to anonymize prompt failures for product/regression tracking.

marta_cs: One more ask — product team wants the top ~20 failing prompts to wire into our regression suite. Vik, can you confirm customer is OK to share anonymized examples?

vik_sales: Confirmed — they'll provide anonymized set by EOD today. Sending access link and procurement contact. :rocket:

marta_cs: Great — I'll update the CS portal with owners and next-steps, and follow up after Tue sync. Thanks everyone.
